stage_d_evidence.quality_evidence: Current rounded checkpoint curves and independently checked final float64 endpoint summaries, with failures and native early termination retained.
stage_d_evidence.oracle_evidence: Use the dedicated same-device cost/error/regret diagnostics. Kernel call counts are not interchangeable with native sample counts.
stage_d_evidence.memory_evidence: Tables report observed instrumented process peaks, including preparation/diagnostics. Small-instance peaks do not establish capacity or speed at larger sizes.
stage_d_evidence.decision_rule: Complete the prescribed Stage C evidence; require correct kernels, a useful measured oracle cost/error trade-off, competitive feasible outputs, and memory headroom. No arbitrary quality threshold or automatic winner is introduced.
stage_d_evidence.theory_caveat: Dedicated figures use true gradients. Practical checkpoint gaps are sparse diagnostics, not a full-trajectory theorem average. Tuned constants and row projection are not new theorem guarantees.
